items.question: Ranitidine reduces acid secretion by blocking?
items.explanation: Ranitidine is an H2-receptor antagonist reducing histamine-stimulated acid secretion.

items.question: Domperidone is a prokinetic preferred over metoclopramide because it causes fewer?
items.explanation: Domperidone poorly crosses the blood-brain barrier, so it causes fewer extrapyramidal effects.

items.question: Which drug is used in chemotherapy-induced delayed emesis as an NK1 antagonist?
items.explanation: Aprepitant blocks substance P at NK1 receptors; added for delayed chemotherapy-induced nausea.

items.question: Vedolizumab is gut-selective in IBD because it targets?
items.explanation: Vedolizumab blocks the alpha4-beta7 integrin, selectively reducing gut lymphocyte trafficking with few systemic effects.

items.question: Which analytical method separates drugs based on differential partitioning between mobile and stationary phases?
items.explanation: High-performance liquid chromatography separates compounds by their partitioning between phases for quantification.

*PharmaCraft Daily - 17 Nov 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (GIT)
Q: Ranitidine reduces acid secretion by blocking?
Ans: H2 receptors
Why: Ranitidine is an H2-receptor antagonist reducing histamine-stimulated acid secretion.

🌍 *FMGE* (GIT)
Q: Domperidone is a prokinetic preferred over metoclopramide because it causes fewer?
Ans: Central (extrapyramidal) effects
Why: Domperidone poorly crosses the blood-brain barrier, so it causes fewer extrapyramidal effects.

🩺 *NEET PG* (GIT)
Q: Which drug is used in chemotherapy-induced delayed emesis as an NK1 antagonist?
Ans: Aprepitant
Why: Aprepitant blocks substance P at NK1 receptors; added for delayed chemotherapy-induced nausea.

🏥 *INI-CET* (GIT)
Q: Vedolizumab is gut-selective in IBD because it targets?
Ans: Alpha4-beta7 integrin (gut lymphocyte homing)
Why: Vedolizumab blocks the alpha4-beta7 integrin, selectively reducing gut lymphocyte trafficking with few systemic effects.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper I: General/Experimental)
Q: Which analytical method separates drugs based on differential partitioning between mobile and stationary phases?
Ans: HPLC
Why: High-performance liquid chromatography separates compounds by their partitioning between phases for quantification.
